title: ModRM decoded
description:
Decode the ModRM byte (and SIB) into the operands of an instruction.

```
48 89 C8        -> mov rax, rcx
48 8B 45 F8     -> mov rax, [rbp-0x8]
48 8B 04 C8     -> mov rax, [rax+rcx*8]
48 8B 05 10 00 00 00 -> mov rax, [rip+0x10]
```
hints: In `89` the reg field is the source (`mov r/m, reg`); in `8B` it is the destination.
requirements: Split ModRM into mod (2 bits), reg (3) and r/m (3); apply REX.R and REX.B.
Handle mod 0, 1, 2 and 3, the SIB byte when r/m is 4, and RIP-relative when mod is 0 and r/m is 5.
Only the `89` and `8B` forms of `mov` are needed.
stretch: Add `add`, `sub` and `cmp` with their `01`/`03`, `29`/`2B` and `39`/`3B` forms.
